test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
‘M $ K’ means ‘M is the mother of K’.

‘M # K’ means ‘M is the father of K’.

‘M @ K’ means ‘M is the husband of K’.

‘M% K’ means ‘M is the daughter of K’.

If A $ C @ R, then how is R related to A?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 $
 #
 @
 %
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Father
 Husband
 Daughter
 
 

 

Given: A $ C @ R

It means: A is the Mother of C, C is the Husband of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b92eec99b698bdde006fb2aa978153b086b8fa77695865ce2f2bb6af85b879e0.png] 

So, R is the '**Son's wife**' of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
